title: Salt Firing – Ongoing
source_quote: Salt and Reduction firings — ongoing. I am firing both kilns regularly, as soon as there are enough pots to fill them.
evidence_sentence: The homepage invites potters to contact the studio to bring bisqued and wadded pots for ongoing salt firings.
summary: Bring bisqued and wadded pots (Cone 10 clay only) to fire in the studio's Salt Kiln; contact the studio to arrange participation in ongoing firings.
how_to_join: Contact the studio at 917-607-4203 or email
